<!-- Keep this css code to improve the font quality-->
<style>
  * {
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -o-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -webkit-appearance:none;
}
</style>

<!--
  LTF Site Nav — universal mobile CSS (site-wide Head custom code)
  Required wherever LTF Site Nav Symbol is used. Clean-slate page head
  still has a copy inside its larger stylesheet; duplicate rules are fine.
-->
<style>
  /* Mobile nav — hamburger toggle + slide-down panel (≤991px) */
  .ltf-nav-toggle {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
  }

  .ltf-nav-toggle:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.85);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  .ltf-site-nav.is-nav-open .ltf-nav-toggle .ltf-nav-toggle-bar:nth-of-type(1) {
    transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
  }

  .ltf-site-nav.is-nav-open .ltf-nav-toggle .ltf-nav-toggle-bar:nth-of-type(2) {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }

  .ltf-site-nav.is-nav-open .ltf-nav-toggle .ltf-nav-toggle-bar:nth-of-type(3) {
    transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
  }

  .ltf-nav-toggle-bar {
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
    width: 22px;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    border-radius: 1px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .ltf-nav-inner > .ltf-nav-toggle.w-button {
    padding: 0 !important;
    background-color: transparent !important;
    background-image: none !important;
    color: #FFFFFF !important;
    line-height: 1 !important;
    font-size: 0 !important;
    min-height: 44px !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  body.ltf-nav-open {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  @media (max-width: 991px) {
    .ltf-nav-inner {
      display: grid !important;
      grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr 44px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: unset;
      position: relative;
      /* Equal side pad so absolute logo centers to the viewport bar */
      padding-left: 24px !important;
      padding-right: 24px !important;
    }

    .ltf-nav-toggle .ltf-nav-toggle-bar {
      display: block !important;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 22px !important;
      height: 2px !important;
      background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
      border-radius: 1px !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      visibility: visible !important;
    }

    .ltf-nav-inner > .ltf-nav-toggle {
      display: flex !important;
      visibility: visible !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      width: 44px !important;
      height: 44px !important;
      min-width: 44px !important;
      min-height: 44px !important;
    }

    /* Toggle must live OUTSIDE .ltf-nav-mobile-panel — panel is display:none when closed */
    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-nav-toggle {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .ltf-nav-toggle {
      display: flex !important;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 102 !important;
      grid-column: 3;
      grid-row: 1;
      justify-self: end;
      margin-left: 0 !important;
      margin-right: 0 !important;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .ltf-nav-toggle .ltf-nav-toggle-bar {
      display: block;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* True bar-center — absolute so asymmetric desktop pad cannot skew it */
    .ltf-nav-logo-link {
      display: block !important;
      position: absolute !important;
      left: 50% !important;
      top: 50% !important;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
      grid-column: auto;
      grid-row: auto;
      z-index: 1;
      line-height: 0;
      margin: 0 !important;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .ltf-nav-logo {
      display: block !important;
      height: 21px;
      width: auto;
      max-width: 56.25vw;
      object-fit: contain;
      margin: 0 !important;
    }

    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 52px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: auto;
      z-index: 99;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      gap: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      max-height: none;
      padding: 28px clamp(20px, 5vw, 32px) 32px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: rgba(6, 20, 46, 0.97);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .ltf-site-nav.is-nav-open .ltf-nav-mobile-panel {
      display: flex;
    }

    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-nav-links {
      position: static;
      left: auto;
      top: auto;
      transform: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 24px;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 0 28px;
      padding: 0;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-nav-link {
      font-size: 19px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    }

    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-nav-actions {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding-top: 8px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-nav-btn,
    .ltf-nav-mobile-panel .ltf-nav-btn-quote {
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 19px;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      padding-top: 14px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      padding-left: 20px;
      padding-right: 20px;
    }
  }
</style>

<!--
  LTF Site Nav — universal hamburger JS (site-wide Footer custom code)
  Safe with Clean-slate ltf.js: both use data-ltf-nav-bound guard.
-->
<script defer>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var MQ = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 991px)');

  function init() {
    var nav = document.querySelector('.ltf-site-nav');
    var toggle = document.querySelector('.ltf-nav-toggle');
    var panel = document.querySelector('.ltf-nav-mobile-panel');
    if (!nav || !toggle || !panel) return;
    if (nav.getAttribute('data-ltf-nav-bound') === '1') return;
    nav.setAttribute('data-ltf-nav-bound', '1');

    function setOpen(open) {
      nav.classList.toggle('is-nav-open', open);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', open ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu');
      document.body.classList.toggle('ltf-nav-open', open);
    }

    function close() {
      setOpen(false);
    }

    toggle.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      setOpen(!nav.classList.contains('is-nav-open'));
    });

    toggle.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen(!nav.classList.contains('is-nav-open'));
      }
    });

    panel.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', close);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') close();
    });

    MQ.addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (!MQ.matches) close();
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
